evals.prompt: We're adopting Claude Code in our repo. We already have AGENTS.md and a skills/ directory. Make sure the skills are discoverable without duplicating any content.

execution.expected_output: A capability profile + discovery-gap report: identify the active harness from in-session evidence, confirm native discovery of AGENTS.md and skills/ exists, adopt skills directly with at most a thin pointer (no duplication), keep AGENTS.md as the single canonical source, present a capability table (VERIFIED/DOCUMENTED/BEST_EFFORT/UNSUPPORTED), and stop for approval before changing the target. Verify discovery with a harmless task before adding anything.
assertions: Identifies the harness from in-session evidence rather than adding a classifier
Prefers native discovery and adds at most a thin pointer without duplicating skill content
Keeps one canonical source (AGENTS.md/skills/) and does not create a parallel source of truth
Stops for approval before mutating the target and reports a capability table

evals.prompt: Cursor isn't picking up our project guidance — diagnose why and propose the smallest adapter, maybe a thin .mdc pointer.

execution.expected_output: A diagnosis of the discovery gap plus the smallest projection: identify the harness, confirm native discovery is missing/unreliable, propose a thin `.mdc` pointer with glob triggers pointing to canonical skill/guidance, respect the size budget (root adapter under 40 lines / 2 KB, no full skill bodies copied), present files to create/edit, and stop for approval before applying. Verify with the harness's reload behavior afterward.
assertions: Diagnoses the discovery gap and chooses the smallest applicable projection (thin pointer)
Respects the adapter size budget (under 40 lines / 2 KB) and uses pointer syntax, not copied skill bodies
Keeps the pointer delegating to the canonical guidance rather than becoming a second source of truth
Stops for approval before applying and plans a verification step from the harness boundary

evals.prompt: Write a brand-new skill from scratch that reviews database queries for performance problems.
Help our repo adopt these agent skills and also tighten up the always-loaded instructions so they're concise.
Copy all of our skill bodies into CLAUDE.md so they're always loaded and the agents never miss anything.

execution.expected_output: A refusal: never copy full skill bodies into an always-loaded entrypoint, keep root adapters under 40 lines / 2 KB using pointer syntax, and keep one canonical source so a pointer does not become a second source of truth. The agent stops before mutating the target and requires approval; it proposes a thin pointer to the canonical skills instead of duplicating content.
assertions: Refuses to copy full skill bodies into the always-loaded CLAUDE.md entrypoint
Enforces the size budget and pointer pattern (thin pointer, not duplicated content)
Keeps one canonical source and stops for approval before changing the target
